author: luna_seed_author
reviewNotes: Article 59(2) of the Civil Procedure Law gives a non-independent third party an appeal right when the judgment determines that party’s civil liability; Article 143 permits default judgment against an absent defendant. D is the only generally correct choice: the defendant乙 can be defaulted. A wrongly applies dismissal to a non-independent third party, B treats the absent plaintiff as a default judgment, and C grants the third party an unconditional appeal right without the liability predicate. The author flags that predicate and holds ready=false; keep the gate. Official law: https://ipc.court.gov.cn/zh-cn/news/view-6231.html .
